specs.title: @probe PRB-00 the preview under test answers health and reports the commit these probes ran against
@probe PRB-01 AC-004.8 every staff route with no session, an empty, undefined, garbage or anon-key bearer answers 401 and no data
@probe PRB-01 positive control (owner): a real staff token is accepted, so the 401s above are not a blanket refusal
@probe PRB-01 positive control (helper): a real staff token is accepted, so the 401s above are not a blanket refusal
@probe PRB-02 a tampered, re-signed-by-nobody or "alg none" token is refused (401 from the app, or Vercel's own edge refusal)
@probe PRB-03 a signed-in session cookie with no bearer token is not a session for the API
@probe PRB-04 unknown ids answer 404 not_found; malformed ids never reach the database (no 5xx, no database text)
@probe PRB-05 a method the contract does not list answers 405 method_not_allowed (a request can never be deleted)
@probe PRB-06 AC-004.10 there is no route or page to change or reset a password, sign up, or recover; nothing is sent
@probe PRB-06b an unknown path answers 404 whatever the method or headers (pinpoints what turns a 404 into a 200)
@probe PRB-07 FR-26 a signed-out visit to a staff page is sent to /sign-in with the tab it asked for, and the page holds no request data
@probe PRB-08 malformed sign-in bodies are refused with a clean 4xx, set no session and are never a 5xx
@probe PRB-10 Bearer undefined, empty, missing, wrong, a staff token and the anon key all give 401 on both job routes
@probe PRB-11 a spoofed cron header, a secret in the query string, or another method does not open the job routes
@probe PRB-20 the anon key can read no table (every select is refused, none returns rows)
@probe PRB-21 the anon key can write no table (insert, update and delete are all refused as permission errors)
@probe PRB-22 (owner) a staff token reads only the six readable tables; pending requests are invisible; events and jobs hold no personal data
@probe PRB-23 (owner) a staff token can write no table directly (insert, update, delete): every change goes through the RPCs
@probe PRB-22 (helper) a staff token reads only the six readable tables; pending requests are invisible; events and jobs hold no personal data
@probe PRB-23 (helper) a staff token can write no table directly (insert, update, delete): every change goes through the RPCs
@probe PRB-28 a staff token stops working the moment its session is signed out (the API and the database both refuse it)
@probe PRB-24 service-only functions are closed to anon and staff tokens; staff functions are closed to anon
@probe PRB-25 the private schemas (app_private, auth, storage) are not exposed through the REST API
@probe PRB-26 Supabase Auth: sign-up, anonymous sign-in and one-time-link creation are off (no account, no session, nothing sent)
@probe PRB-27 the Supabase URL probed is the one the staging app uses (so these results describe the app's own database)
@probe PRB-30 AC-003.2 AC-003.7 30 honeypot submissions from one address are all refused alike, store nothing, and make one spam event with count 30 and no address
@probe PRB-31 AC-003.3 a token under 3 seconds old is refused with the same body as the honeypot; a missing, forged or garbage token is 401
@probe PRB-32 AC-003.4 SEC-3 20 parallel creates from one address accept exactly 5, refuse 15 with 429 and Retry-After, store exactly 5 and write one rate_limited event
@probe PRB-33 AC-001.17 every request stored with offers value "maybe" has consent no, no consent time and no GoHighLevel copy; only a JSON true differs from a stored no
@probe PRB-34 a token cannot complete another request; an unknown id, a missing token and a forged token are refused

suites.title: staff write boundaries and stored script text @probe

specs.title: @probe PRB-40 extra fields on the staff writes (status, reference, consent, id, from_status, changed_by) are refused or ignored, never applied
@probe PRB-41 write boundaries: price, note, version and status are validated (422 with the field, 409 stale, explicit null accepted where optional), never a 5xx
@probe PRB-42 AC-014.4 a copy retry on an unticked request is 409 not_retryable and changes nothing
@probe PRB-43 AC-001.5 script text a homeowner sent (and one a staff member saved) shows as plain text on the list, the board and the detail, on a phone and a desktop, and never runs
@probe PRB-50 AC-004.5 AC-004.12 five wrong passwords for a throwaway email, then attempts 6 to 20 are refused with one 429 body and no Retry-After
@probe PRB-51 a pause on a throwaway email does not stop the owner signing in (a successful sign-in, not counted)
@probe PRB-52 FR-26 the sign-in "next" value is followed only for /requests and /pipeline; an absolute or protocol-relative address lands on /requests
@probe PRB-67 the checker itself: an undocumented field, a missing field and a wrong type are each reported (so a pass above means something)
@probe PRB-63 every GET response conforms to the generated schema and holds no undocumented field
@probe PRB-64 error bodies are the contract problem+json: the status matches, the code is documented, nothing leaks
@probe PRB-68 responses that carry personal data or signed photo links are not cacheable by a shared cache (Cache-Control no-store or private)
@probe PRB-66 list parameters at their edges: limit, status, q and cursor are validated (never a 5xx); search text that looks like a filter or SQL finds nothing
@probe PRB-60 every page sends a nonce CSP that forbids framing, plus nosniff, a referrer policy and X-Frame-Options DENY; two loads get different nonces
@probe PRB-61 no CORS: a call from another origin gets no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, on the API, the form routes and the job routes
@probe PRB-62 invariant 2 no service-role key, private key, signing secret or provider token appears in any page or script the app ships
@probe PRB-70 AC-002.1 a homeowner can upload into the folder of her own pending request, for planned positions only
@probe PRB-71 a 4th photo, a name or folder of someone else, overwrite, delete, copy, move and every read of an unsubmitted photo are refused
@probe PRB-72 AC-002.4 an oversize file, a wrong type and a text file named like a JPEG never become part of a request; a token cannot complete another request
@probe PRB-73 AC-002.8 once submitted, photos are readable only by staff through a 900-second signed URL; no direct address returns them; a changed or missing token fails

@probe PRB-74 AC-003.3 every valid edge of every field is accepted on one pending request (same token, changed answers updates it): name 2 and 100, address 5 and 200, problem 10 and 2000, email 254, phone shapes, every urgency
@probe PRB-74b createQuoteRequest invalid input is 422 and names the field; odd text and explicit null never cause a 5xx; malformed bodies are 400
@probe PRB-75 mass assignment on create: status, price, reference, consent time, id, contact id and state sent as extra fields are refused (422) or ignored, never applied
@probe PRB-76 the requests this run stored are the only ones it left visible to staff (and the pending ones are not visible)
